description: This Dart source file defines the singleton class AppDatabase, which manages the initialization, configuration, schema creation, migrations, and access to an SQLite database for a Flutter expense tracker app. It includes setup routines for tables related to categories, budgets, and transactions, along with handling schema migrations, seeding default data, and database file path management.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for initializing and managing the SQLite database, including schema creation, migrations, and seeding for a Flutter expense tracking application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database connection by setting the database file path, configuring settings, creating the initial schema if needed, and applying migrations. It also seeds default data on first creation or after upgrades.

methods.name: _createV1Schema
methods.description: Creates the initial database schema with tables for categories, budgets, and transactions, including indexes.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database connection if it is open.
